audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup is built around Miasma "grounding" Mel — it is the focus note, the tldr-adjacent line, the cooldowns entry, a dosFull description and the Key Ability Interactions row. Grounding does nothing to Mel.
audit.why: Grounding disables movement abilities. Mel's kitFlags contain no dash entry — Radiant Volley, Rebuttal, Solar Snare and Golden Eclipse are all non-movement. The real threat in Miasma is the slow, which holds her inside Twin Fang's 700 range, and the damage over time.
audit.corrected: Reframed every one of those lines around the slow. The point is now that the grounding is free and the slow is not.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] read "Reflect Miasma back the moment he commits". Miasma is several ground-placed poison clouds and cannot be reflected.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged this matchup as having NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere. That was accurate.

GENERATOR ROOT CAUSE: champ-data/_gen-engine.js line 154 reads  cassiopeia: { slot:'W', name:'Miasma', cd:'12s', note:'Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it.' }.  Two problems. Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16, so 12s is wrong at every rank. And the note is emitted into every owner's Cassiopeia entry regardless of whether that owner has a dash — for Mel, who has none, the headline interaction of the matchup is a non-interaction. Fixing the table row fixes it everywhere. I did not touch _gen-engine.js.

Same file, line 151:  mel: { slot:'W', name:'Rebuttal', cd:'20s' }.  Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26. That single wrong value is the source of the "gone for twenty seconds" line that appears in every one of Mel's 71 matchups and in every enemy's Mel entry. This is the highest-leverage number fix in the dataset.

Sample size: MC_REAL_GAMES.mel.cassiopeia is 5 games — the smallest in my slice. 40% is 2 wins in 5. I did not let it move anything.

Layer contradiction left alone: content win[6] is "Mel" while full phases[6].side is "Cassiopeia". A side flip is outside the +/-10% length band.
